limitations: Manufactured static in-plane images; no experimental or VIC-2D ground truth.
Local texture mixing and Gaussian blur are controlled stress tests, not a calibrated camera degradation model.
Accepted-point error is always accompanied by whole-domain and neck-band coverage; a numerical quality pass does not certify resolved peaks.
No temporal reference update is implemented or inferred from this fixed-reference study.

ideal_intermediate_reference_diagnostic.initialization: exact material point, displacement and deformation gradients in both routes
ideal_intermediate_reference_diagnostic.interpretation: Only the final local solve is measured; earlier correspondence and displacement are exact. Equal pixel subset widths in different reference images do not represent identical material footprints. No accumulated tracking error or full-field strain composition is measured.
